policy.news: Short Yahoo/ESPN-style current update: status or latest game, concise context, next opponent, and material injury/role news only. No internal model jargon.
policy.scouting: Persistent player-specific football thesis used to interpret new evidence, including historical classification, role/volume case, production and ceiling case, risks, connected-player context and unresolved questions.
policy.ranking: Fresh evidence is compared with the existing scouting thesis and canonical baseline before component or rank changes. Prior applied evidence is not counted twice. Regular-season usage supersedes camp evidence when it answers the same football question.
